mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/791af8040466-t1/ws/data/prep_D568 && cat > /srv/leakruns/791af8040466-t1/ws/data/prep_D568/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_D568 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 테이블 생성 (학습/평가 없음).
설계와 다르게 처리한 부분은 [수정] 주석으로 표시. 설계 확정 전 임시 처리임."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

D = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.load(open(D.parent / "design_D568.json"))

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 퇴원 후 30일 안에 시작
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a.next_admit > a.tp) & (a.next_admit <= a.tp + pd.Timedelta("30D"))).astype(int)
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()
a["followup_complete"] = a.tp + pd.Timedelta("30D") <= data_end  # [수정] 행정적 중도절단 표시

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c.age >= 18]
c = c[c.discharge_status != "died"].copy()

def window(df, tcol, start="admit_time"):
    m = df.merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m[start]) & (m[tcol] <= m.tp)]

# 검사: hgb는 설계대로 report_time. [수정] cr_last도 report_time 기준(설계는 collect_time → 퇴원 후 보고값 유입)
hgb = window(labs[labs.test == "hemoglobin"], "report_time")
c["hgb_min"] = c.admission_id.map(hgb.groupby("admission_id").value.min())
cr = window(labs[labs.test == "creatinine"], "report_time").sort_values("collect_time")
c["cr_last"] = c.admission_id.map(cr.groupby("admission_id").value.last())

dia = window(orders[orders.order_type == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(dia.admission_id).astype(int)

# [수정] 진단: 시각 정보가 없어 '현재 입원'으로 범위 한정 (퇴원 시점 가용성은 미확인)
pre = dx.icd_code.str[:3]
c["dx_ckd"] = c.admission_id.isin(dx[pre == "N18"].admission_id).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c.admission_id.isin(dx[pre == "I50"].admission_id).astype(int)
c["n_dx"] = c.admission_id.map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # a 전체 기준 순번 = 이전 입원 수
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.admission_id.map(a.assign(k=a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()).set_index("admission_id").k)
c["los_h"] = (c.discharge_time - c.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # 원본에 컬럼 없음 → 파생

# [수정] 분할: 가족 단위(family_id 없으면 patient_id)로 묶음
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna(c.patient_id)
s = design["split"]
groups = np.sort(c.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(s["seed"])
test_g = set(rng.choice(groups, int(round(len(groups) * s["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
c["split"] = np.where(c.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + feats
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "model_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_rows": len(c), "n_patients": c.patient_id.nunique(),
    "outcome_rate": round(c.readmit_30d.mean(), 4),
    "followup_incomplete": int((~c.followup_complete).sum()),
    "split_counts": c.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_by_split": c.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "outcome_by_discharge_status": c.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "outcome_by_unit": c.groupby("unit").readmit_30d.agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "missing_rate": c[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_cross_split_if_patient_key": None,
}
# 설계대로 patient_id로 나눴을 때 가족이 train/test에 걸치는지 확인
pg = np.sort(c.patient_id.unique())
tp_ = set(np.random.default_rng(s["seed"]).choice(pg, int(round(len(pg) * s["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
fam = c[c.family_id.notna()].assign(t=lambda x: x.patient_id.isin(tp_))
summary["family_cross_split_if_patient_key"] = int((fam.groupby("family_id").t.nunique() > 1).sum())
summary["n_families"] = int(fam.family_id.nunique())
json.dump(summary, open(OUT / "prep_summary.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
